# Changelog

## 0.1.0-dev2 — 2026-08-31

- Clarify the exact `/HELP` and `/VERSION` aliases on the help screen.

## 0.1.0-dev1 — 2026-08-31

- Add read-only checks for BSH, BLM, EXM, DSM, directory reservation, CKS,
  and required DPH pointers.
- Add optional drive selection and the common help, information, and version
  interface.
- Add native ZSM4 and Digital Research LINK builds and a verified Montezuma
  Micro 80T SUPER DS DATA 880K development image.
